title: 36 Hours in Santo Domingo
abstract: Whether one believes it was Columbus who actually discovered America or not, he clearly left his mark on the breezy capital of the Dominican Republic.

title: 36 Hours in Santa Barbara
abstract: With its perpetually blue skies and taco stands, Santa Barbara, Calif., remains a laid-back town where the star attraction is still the beach.

title: 36 Hours in Seattle
abstract: Fashionable boutiques and gourmet shops are making the city center feel like a neighborhood again, and not just a backdrop for a Space Needle snapshot.

title: 36 Hours in Phoenix
abstract: The city may be an inferno in the summer, but the other nine months of the year are a perfect time to visit its top-notch golf courses, fashionable resorts and cool night life.
